label: Bible Study
prompt: Six days shalt thou _____, and do all thy work:
verse: Six days shalt thou labour, and do all thy work:
note: The Sabbath commandment starts with work, not rest — six days of it, then the seventh belongs to the LORD.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Sanctify them through thy truth: thy _____ is truth.
verse: Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.
note: In His prayer for the disciples, Jesus says it plainly: thy word is truth.

label: Sunday School
prompt: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down, after they were _____ about seven days.
verse: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down, after they were compassed about seven days.
note: Jericho's walls fell after Israel compassed the city seven days — 'compassed' is KJV for marched around.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But go ye and learn what that meaneth, I will have mercy, and not _____: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
verse: But go ye and learn what that meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
note: Pharisees grumbled about Jesus dining with tax collectors, so he assigned them homework: go study Hosea 6:6.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls; every several gate was of one pearl: and the street of the city was pure gold, as it were _____ glass.
verse: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls; every several gate was of one pearl: and the street of the city was pure gold, as it were transparent glass.
note: Pearl gates, and a street of gold so pure it is 'as it were transparent glass.' Heaven's paving is see-through.
